key_moments.title: Chapter 1 Introduction
We discuss how to choose the right home loan term or the right home loan tenure
You need give home loan term equal importance when you are about to take a home loan
Or, shorter home loan term will mean a larger home loan EMI
Basically, it is a trade-off between EMI affordability and the overall interest you pay during the loan term
Why people don't sense the pain of a longer home loan tenure is it doesn't squeeze the home budget
Each person's needs and financial realities should determine the best home loan term
Home loan with terms of more than 5 years are termed as long term home loans
Let's take a Rs 35 lakh home loan at 7.55% p.a interest
But you pay additional Rs 9 lakh as interest
You only save Rs 2,274 in EMI but pay Rs 10 lakh extra
For higher interest rate, the effect will be even more
You need to pay far more attention to home loan term than people do
Lowest home interest rate is the only important thing to watch out for when taking a home loan
There are factors related to your realities that should determine your home loan term
With subsequent increases in income, you can keep servicing the home loan EMIs and then partly or full prepay the loan
Larger the income, larger the home loan you can take and larger the EMI you can pay
When you try to make your EMI affordable by opting for a longer home loan term, you are adding to your interest burden
With a hike in interest rates, you might choose to extend the home loan term
In such a case, you will not mind a shorter home loan term
More the outstanding loans, more inevitable is a longer home loan term
Eventually, you could partly or fully prepay the loan and retire it
In case of home loan rate hikes, you should have the headroom to extend the loan term
They will offer a home loan term that ensures that you fully repay the loan before your retirement
The young also benefit from the home loan tax benefits that ease the pressure on the budget
